Consent API endpoints and tool exposure

SHARED-F-2-S63.title: Consent Data Schema and Storage Contract
SHARED-F-2-S63.description: Define and implement the data schema for consent records, including tier level, timestamp, user/session linkage, and storage rules governing identifiable vs de-identified data.

SHARED-F-2-S64.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Router Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S64.description: Expose consent capture and query functionality via FastAPI endpoints and register corresponding tools in the tool_router to allow LLM-driven consent workflows.

SHARED-F-2-S65.title: Consent Persistence and Audit Logging
SHARED-F-2-S65.description: Implement persistence of consent decisions and transitions with audit logging, ensuring traceability of consent state changes and compliance with HIPAA audit expectations.

SHARED-F-2-S66.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S66.description: Integrate consent enforcement across dependent services including lead capture, unknown question handling, and safety flows to ensure consistent application of consent rules platform-wide.
